mapper.select: SELECT ai.id, ai.uid, ai.name, ai.serial_num, ai.financing_num, ai.qr_code, ai.function_type, ai.asset_group, ai.clinical_dept_name, ai.measure_grade, ai.measuring_item_category, mcd.certificate_no, mcd.status, mcd.type measuring_type, mcd.check_company last_check_company, ai.last_metering_date, mcd.valid_date_to next_metering_date, mcd.check_date, mcd.id as bo_uuid FROM asset_info ai INNER JOIN measuring_certificate_detail mcd ON mcd.asset_uid = ai.uid ${ew.sqlSegment}
select ai.* from asset_info ai left join nurse_site_maintain_config_item nsmci on ai.uid = nsmci.asset_uid ${ew.sqlSegment}
select ai.* from asset_info ai left join nurse_site_maintain_config_item_jn nsmci on ai.uid = nsmci.asset_uid ${ew.sqlSegment}

select count(*) from asset_info ai LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, asset_id, row_number()over(partition by asset_id order by created_date desc) FROM v2_work_order WHERE tenant_uid = #{tenantUid} AND status = 1 ) wo ON ai.id = wo.asset_id AND wo.row_number = 1

where.if:
AND ( ai.name like concat('%',#{oneSearchStr},'%') or ai.name_py_code like concat('%',#{oneSearchStr},'%') or ai.depart_num like concat('%',#{oneSearchStr},'%') or ai.financing_num like concat('%',#{oneSearchStr},'%') or ai.qr_code like concat('%',#{oneSearchStr},'%')
or ai.serial_num like concat('%',#{oneSearchStr},'%')
or ai.manufacture like concat('%',#{oneSearchStr},'%')
or ai.clinical_dept_name like concat('%',#{oneSearchStr},'%') )
